name: Cartesian
summary: A quiet museum catalogue drawn with compass and rule: warm stone, thin Playfair Display, taupe hairlines and faint compass rings that draw themselves round, words traced on left to right, and no colour at all. Sparse and breathing.

palette.use: bg-secondary: the only secondary fill: placeholders, photo frames
text-primary: headlines; the one ink accent rule
line: every structural line; the quote mark
taupe: labels, numerals, small text, compass rings, the active caption word's underline

type.case: sentence case Playfair, never uppercase; uppercase taupe labels
type.emphasis: grow the type, switch sans to serif, one italic word, or the one ink rule; never colour

layout.empty: 55-60% of every frame is empty; there's no dense frame

banned: a populist accent: no red, blue or green, even when the subject is colour
bold Playfair; taupe headlines; uppercase Playfair
borders of 2 px or more; shadows, elevated cards, rounded rectangles (circles only)
crowding; more than 2 compass decorations in a frame; edge-to-edge headlines
a hero numeral: stats stay modest
bounce, overshoot, anything fast; moves under 0.5 s except the exit

sources.what: HyperFrames frame preset Cartesian: palette, faces, type ramp, elements, frames, banned list, caption skin
